name: @sponsorcoin/spcoin-feeds
description: Real accounts/tokens/networks data feeds (fetchers, in-memory caching, mappers to spcoin-panels' UI shapes) for MeritWallet — shared between spcoin-nextjs-front-end and the Merit Wallet browser extension (spCoinExtension). Deliberately has zero dependency on @sponsorcoin/spcoin-common (and therefore zero wagmi/viem transitive weight) — none of these three domains need its canonical types.
author: Robert Lanson
